2a-grey: Clipper Conquest is played by two teams, the red team and the blue team, that race to conquer as many San Francisco neighborhoods as possible.
Whichever team has more neighborhoods when the clock hits zero is the winner.
2b-challenges: Every one of the city's 41 neighborhoods has three unique challenges.
For example, one challenge might ask you to get three antique arcade machines running at the same time.
Another might ask two teammates to count the sea lions at Pier 39 and agree on the number.
Whichever team has completed more of a neighborhood's challenges holds it.
3a-muni: You get around on Muni, and only Muni: buses, Metro, streetcars and cable cars.
No BART, no Caltrain, no cars and no bikes.
And no running unless a challenge says to.
4a-phone: When you finish a challenge, take a photo.
4b-upload: Then upload it in the app and tap Complete.
The moment you log it is the moment it counts.

6a-tiebreak: Ties go to whichever team reached that count first.

6b-sweep: Complete all three and the neighborhood is locked.
7a-costs: One challenge grabs a neighborhood fast, but it can be stolen.

8a-end: Whichever team has more neighborhoods when the clock hits zero wins.
